memory.content: Posting rules: no questions in posts, only confident statements. Never invent statistics. Include the product link once per post.

skills.name: X product promotion campaign
skills.description: Use this to run a recurring X (Twitter) and Telegram promotion campaign for a product. It covers posts, replies, company tags, retweets and Spaces through one shared logged-in browser.
skills.content:
---
name: X product promotion campaign
description: >-
  Use this to run a recurring X (Twitter) and Telegram promotion campaign for a
  product. It covers posts, replies, company tags, retweets and Spaces through
  one shared logged-in browser.
---
# Configuration (edit these first)

- `PRODUCT_URL`: the link to promote, included once per post. Default: none, so you must set it.
- `PRODUCT_PITCH`: one or two sentences on what the product offers.
- `LEAD_MESSAGE`: the opening idea every post rewords.
- `TONE_RULES`: default rules are no questions, confident statements only, no invented stats, and jabs at public figures framed as opinion only.
- `X_ACCOUNT`: the posting handle, already signed in on the box browser.
- `TELEGRAM_CHANNEL`: optional channel for cross-posts.
- `LOG_DIR`: default `/workspace/leads/`. Use one CSV per stream, with columns for timestamp, target, url and text.
- `STREAMS_AND_CADENCE` (cron, local time). Defaults:
  - relevant replies hourly
  - tag 1 company per region list hourly, each in its local language
  - batch mention queue hourly
  - trending-keyword post hourly
  - punchy posts every 2h
  - tips quote-tweets every 2h
  - builder retweets every 2h
  - news posts with sourced figures every 4h
  - themed humor posts every 3 to 4h
  - Spaces check hourly
  - Telegram cross-post hourly
  - Stagger the minutes so streams don't overlap.
- `SPACES_MIN_LISTENERS`: default 5 for on-topic Spaces and more than 10 for general Spaces.
- `RETWEET_COOLDOWN_DAYS`: default 3. `TAG_COOLDOWN_DAYS`: default 7.
- `LOCK_WAIT_MIN`: default 25. `LOCK_STALE_MIN`: default 20.
- `NOTIFY_ON`: default is problems only (captcha, sign-out, rate limit, spam warning).

# Each run
1. Take the browser lock with `mkdir $LOG_DIR/x_browser.lock`.
   - If the lock is held, wait up to `LOCK_WAIT_MIN` minutes.
   - Clear a lock older than `LOCK_STALE_MIN` minutes.
   - If the wait runs out, log a skip and stop.
2. Open a new tab. Never touch a tab that's playing a Space. Close your tab when done.
3. Read this stream's log so you don't repeat a target, a trend or wording.
4. Pick the target for this stream:
   - **Replies:** an on-topic post. Prefer long reply chains.
   - **Tags:** a verified, active company from the region list. Skip companies that are inactive, blocked, sanctioned or recently breached. When the list runs out, research and add a new batch.
   - **Spaces:** a live Space that meets the listener minimum. Join muted as a listener. Never request to speak.
5. Write the post: open with a reworded `LEAD_MESSAGE`, then add `PRODUCT_PITCH` and `PRODUCT_URL`. Keep replies short enough that the link stays visible.
6. Post once. Check that the post is live before you ever click Post again. Delete any accidental duplicate.
7. Plain-retweet the account's pinned post, or its latest clean original if nothing is pinned. Skip scam, sexual or offensive content and anything inside the cooldown.
8. Append rows to the logs, release the lock, and report the post URL. Notify the owner only for items in `NOTIFY_ON`.

# Rules
- Skip blocked accounts. Never unblock anyone.
- Don't delete posts you didn't write unless the owner asks.

skills.name: getting-started-x-promo
skills.description: Use this in the first conversation with a new owner to set up the X and Telegram product promotion bot.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started-x-promo
description: >-
  Use this in the first conversation with a new owner to set up the X and
  Telegram product promotion bot.
---
I promote your product on X (and optionally Telegram). I post, reply, tag companies, retweet similar builders and join Spaces, all on a schedule.

Ask these one at a time:
1. What product are we promoting? Give me its link and a one- or two-sentence pitch.
2. What core message should every post open with, and are there tone rules?
3. Which X account do I post from? Sign it in on my computer's browser when I open the page.
4. Is there a Telegram channel to cross-post to?
5. Which streams do you want, and how often?
6. Should I post without asking each time, or show you drafts first?

Then:
- Save the answers as memories.
- Fill in the configuration of the X product promotion campaign skill.
- Create one routine per chosen stream, with staggered minutes.
- Run one stream once to confirm it works.
